description: Convert between 1-3999 and Roman numerals, both ways.

faqs.a: Standard Roman numerals stop at 3999 because there is no standard single symbol for 5000 in basic notation. This tool converts integers from 1 to 3999.
After parsing, the result is converted back to Roman and compared with the input. Forms like IIII, VV or IL fail this round-trip check and are rejected.
faqs.q: How are invalid numerals like IIII rejected?

faqs.a: Yes — both directions are supported; pick the mode first.
faqs.q: Can I convert Roman numerals back to numbers?

howto: Type a number (1-3999) or a Roman numeral.
Non-canonical forms like IIII or VV are rejected with an error.
title: Roman Numeral Converter
